correctness.rationale: An equal-output 256-vertex pair graph has an off-diagonal closed walk of length N exactly for a collision of the N-site map. Standard SCC period theory shows odd collisions exactly when a cyclic off-diagonal SCC period is odd, and twice-odd collisions exactly when a relevant period is not divisible by four. The exhaustive C11 program enumerates all 65,472 exact-degree-two ANF masks, uses two separately coded Tarjan/modular-coloring and Kosaraju/period-gcd procedures with complete agreement and exact 32/8 masks, and independently enumerates finite rings N=9,10,15. The 32/8 positive rules are known elementary odd-ring bijections after spatial shift and stride-two conjugacies. Finite direct rings are not substituted for the proven SCC period reduction. Formal assumptions and quantifiers are fully specified.

value.rationale: The odd/twice-odd bijectivity questions are natural infinite congruence alternatives to the September 2026 published 4-divisible obstruction for all exactly quadratic five-site rules. An exhaustive 32- and 8-rule structural classification shows a genuine rigidity: all universal odd survivors factor through familiar elementary dynamics, while twice-odd survivorship forces doubled spatial spacing. The result provides a substantive, closed, reproducible infinite-ring classification, not an arbitrary small numeric lookup.
